descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role The Repair Center Coordinator is responsible for supporting equipment repair project planning, execution, and monitoring. The role involves working independently with general supervision and contributing to project success through technical and analytical support. Key Responsibilities
• Assist in developing project plans, schedules, and estimates.
• Monitor project progress and report on milestones.
• Provide technical and analytical support to project teams.
• Ensure adherence to quality and safety standards.
• Liaise with users to gather and document requirements.
• Support vendor coordination and deliverable tracking. Skills & Qualifications
• Typically a University degree (or equivalent work experience) and at least 3–4 years of relevant experience (or equivalent skills) are minimally required to carry out the role.
• Solid understanding of project management principles.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Effective communication and teamwork.
• Familiarity with project planning tools.
• Ability to work independently with general supervision. What we offer you
• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays
• 401k plan with a 6% match
• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability
• Motivating wellness program
• Employee Assistance Program
• Paid paternal leave
• Gym re-imbursement Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.
